name: Farmer's Carry
summary: A loaded walk that builds grip strength, trap and core stability and general carrying capacity.
setup: Place two heavy dumbbells or handles at your sides and hinge down with a flat back.
Grip them firmly and stand up tall.
Pull the shoulder blades down and back and brace the abs.
execution: Walk with short, quick steps, keeping the torso upright.
Keep the weights hanging by your sides without swinging.
Breathe steadily and keep the head neutral.
Walk for the set distance or time, then lower the weights under control.
mistakes: Leaning to one side: use equal loads and keep the shoulders level.
Shrugging the shoulders up: keep them down and packed.
Taking long, bouncing steps: shorten the stride.
Letting the grip fail early: use a weight you can hold for the whole distance.
